title: Normalized finite-clopen strict-system comparison
statement: In the fixed coefficient setting [def-pur-conventions], let $g:X\to Y$ have a compactification $c=(a,p)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] and let $j:X_i\hookrightarrow X$ be open and closed. A normalized clopen strict-system comparison consists of the component restriction and zero insertion of [lem-pur-finite-clopen-derived-decomposition] on the actual strict etale systems of [lem-pur-etale-coefficient-system-adjoint], its derived right-adjoint comparison $r_iG_g\simeq G_{g_i}$, and its finite evaluations. Its compact-support comparison is the image under the SAME proper direct image of the extension-by-zero composition comparison, fixed as the mate of the canonical restriction-composition map. Its exceptional comparison is fixed by the counit equation $F_{g_i}(\rho_L);\epsilon_{g_i,L}=b^{-1}_{r_iG_gL};F_g(c_{G_gL});\epsilon_{g,L}$. Evaluation carries this equation and its maps to those at every positive coefficient level. The etale/pro-etale system square uses [lem-pur-coefficient-system-derived-comparison], agrees with the canonical comparison-pullback square on underlying sheaves, and is localized termwise. The pro-etale systems are identified with the ringed sequence-site presentation [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site] by the constant-sheaf quotient ring isomorphism fixed on quotient generators, with evaluation and transitions preserved. With the actual reduction system of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], the system exceptional functor is the composite reduction, comparison direct image, strict etale exceptional image, comparison inverse image and sequence realization. The finite exceptional and pullback functors are those of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] and [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. These are definitions of comparison data and normalization equations, with no existence or adjunction postulated.
